name: APF M-1000
description: A late-1970s cartridge console from New York electronics maker APF, built to compete with the Atari 2600. Its controllers combined a joystick with a numeric keypad, and the Imagination Machine add-on turned it into a home computer with BASIC and a cassette drive.
curiosities: The CPU clock is a 3.579 MHz oscillator divided by four.
Each controller has a 4-way joystick and a 13-button keypad.
Docking the console into the Imagination Machine unit added a keyboard, more RAM and a cassette drive.
The console has a built-in game, Rocket Patrol.
